name: dns-multiple-excluded-disjoint-second-invalid
description: Multiple excluded dNSName subtrees of the same type form a union. The CA excludes bad.example.com and evil.example.net; the leaf is under the second excluded subtree, so the chain must be rejected. This catches implementations that keep only the first same-type excluded entry.
notes: Pair with dns-multiple-excluded-disjoint-first-invalid. The two cases make an overwrite bug visible regardless of which entry survives.
